main_measure.name: t of daily-summed (forecast/10) x next-day excess return

statistic.name: t of the mean over days

main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2 with top-minus-bottom third difference > 0; reject t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom third by |forecast| of sign(forecast) x next-day excess return

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more and the top-minus-bottom third difference is above 0.
reading: Every recorded bar with a next-day return in its window is used (zero forecasts included in the daily sums and in the pooled tercile split by |forecast|, ties broken by order), days are UTC dates, a day with cases is one with a nonzero forecast on any coin, and the plan's 1000-day minimum is reported as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.003089 on the check folds against +0.01345 on every fold
